description_en: Retrieves the playback URL of recording files within a specified time range
description_zh: 获取指定时间范围内的录像文件的播放URL
name: QueryRecordUrlByTime

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value exists for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId serves as the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:

0 (default): main stream
1: sub stream
parameters.help_zh:
码流类型：

0（默认）：主码流
1：辅码流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp, in seconds.

Minimum value: 0. Maximum value: 2147483647
parameters.help_zh:
查询范围起始时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。

最小取值为0，最大取值为2147483647
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp, in seconds.

Minimum value: 0. Maximum value: 2147483647
parameters.help_zh:
查询范围结束时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。

最小取值为0，最大取值为2147483647
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the URL. Valid values: 10 to 3600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: URL有效期，取值范围为10~3600，单位为秒
parameters.name: url_valid_duration

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: success.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Data.description_en:
The URL of the recording file. The URL contains authentication information and cannot be reused.

The URL corresponds to all recording files within the specified time range. All recording files are merged for playback
Data.description_zh:
录像文件的URL。URL包含鉴权信息，且无法重复使用。

录像文件的URL对应指定时间范围内所有的录像文件，将所有录像文件合并播放

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
